title: Make identity v2 the actual first-run boot owner
prompt: Use the actual live Ready work-branch state. A critical integration bug was found after identity-v2 activation: index.html still directly loads ready-onboarding-identity-v1.js before ready-stage-c.js. Because identity-v2 returns early when window.ReadyIdentityV1 already exists, the live browser can still run v1 even though Stage-C points to v2. Fix the REAL boot chain, not only the loader constant. Required scope: index.html, _headers, .github/workflows/character-api-contract-test.yml, tests/ready-first-journey-semantics.mjs and/or tests/ready-first-journey-transition.mjs, plus cache/version only if needed. Make index/preboot semantics compatible with explicit characterSetupState=DEFERRED_NO_COST: preboot must consider the bounded deferred-ready state without fabricating characterVisualId, while confirmed character identity still requires a real visual id. Direct script order must use ready-onboarding-identity-v2.js before mood/candidate/stage-c. Update stale headers/contract assertions from v1 to v2. Existing first-journey semantic/browser tests must exercise the actual v2 owner rather than v1. Preserve paid-generation lock, role persistence, parent setup hub, timetable no-free-time-inference, homework candidate-only AI boundary, and existing history/state. Run node syntax checks and the relevant first-journey/character contracts; if Playwright is available, run the mobile-width transition test. Do not touch main/production, switch branches, deploy/release production, or read secrets. Fix in-scope regressions instead of reporting them only. Finish with actual changed files and test evidence.
